what_this_is: The 26+10 row worklist reconciled against the Phase A record, Steven's twelve photo judgments, and the S/N experiments. Statuses are dispositions of the WORKLIST ROW, not of any catalog decision; every recorded decision is preserved.

status.fixed_by_N: the candidate prompt change resolves it
status.accepted_limitation: already accepted by a recorded decision (D3, D4, CAP-007) or costs nothing
status.unresolved_2d: a real defect that no authorized change resolves
status.outside_2d: the defect is upstream wording, catalog wording/coverage, or the Pass 2c kind boundary

defect_class.naming: a wrong or imprecise item where work was still recorded
defect_class.missing_observation: no condition was recorded at all
defect_class.none: nothing was lost; the model's pick stands

billing_consequence.wrong_line: billed under a different line or pricing mode
billing_consequence.lost: a billing that did not happen
